adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the new fallback logic in `updateEvent` is internally inconsistent: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the only time the `find(...)` branch runs), the predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` where `externalCalendarId` is `undefined`/`null`, so it cannot match any real calendar externalId and will always return `undefined`. This makes the fallback ineffective and can lead to calling `events.update` without a meaningful calendarId unless there is an additional default later (not shown in the diff for updateEvent). The defect is directly verifiable from the shown expression.
